meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 装上后,当你要重构代码时,Claude 会先弄清意图、建立代码地图、评估测试覆盖,再制定计划,然后用 LSP 和 AST-grep 逐步执行,每步都跑测试验证,最后跑完整测试套件、类型检查、lint 和构建,并给出改动总结。
howto.when: 当你提到 refactor、cleanup、restructure 等关键词,或指定要重构的文件、符号或代码模式时触发;若请求模糊,它会先追问具体目标。

say.text: 用安全策略重构这个模块,范围只限当前目录
把这段重复代码提取成独立函数,别破坏现有测试
say.note: 提取逻辑属于 extract 触发词

howto.what_en: When asked to refactor, Claude clarifies intent, maps the codebase, assesses test coverage, plans, then executes step-by-step with LSP/AST-grep, running tests after each change and a full suite at the end.
howto.when_en: Triggers on words like refactor, cleanup, restructure, or when a file/symbol/code pattern is specified. If the request is vague, it asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.note: It analyzes dependencies first, verifying each step

say_en.text: Refactor this module with the safe strategy, scope to this directory
Extract this repeated code into a standalone function without breaking tests
say_en.note: Extraction falls under the extract trigger
